title: Fact
description: Represents an assertion linking a person to a source document.

fact_type.description: Standardized category of the historical fact assertion.

date.description: Genealogical date for the fact or null.

description.description: Human- and AI-readable contextual display string summarizing the asserted fact.

notes.description: List of structured research notes adhering to canonical note_entry, or null.

life_story.description: Qualitative narrative describing the human context of the event.

associated_people.description: List of other individuals involved in this event and their specific roles.

external_identifiers.description: Cross-reference mapping to external GEDCOM events and sources.

is_deprecated.description: True if soft-deleted, merged, or invalidated.

superseded_by.description: Pointer to the absorbing canonical UUIDv4 fact_id if consolidated.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp tracking when the fact entry was first created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp tracking when the fact entry was last modified.

source.description: Primary source reference pairing archival URNs with physical filenames.

absorbed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp tracking when this assertion was absorbed by a canonical record.

canonical_fact_id.description: Pointer to the absorbing canonical fact_id if this assertion was consolidated.
